title: Anthropic launches Claude Ship, letting AI agents review, fix, and approve code changes | TechCrunch
summary: Anthropic is moving from having Claude write code to helping developers decide when that code is ready to ship. Code Review is generally available, while PR Steward and Claude Approvals are in beta.
